🚗 Enterprise CAK • Virtual Lot

Large, step-by-step vehicle tracking • last 8 VIN • time only

STEP 1 OF 3

📸 Take a tag picture

Take a photo or choose one you already took. The app will attempt VIN scanning automatically; you can always enter it yourself.

Shiny sleeve? Use a separate close-up photo for scanning

🅿️ Choose a parking spot

Pickup: Washbay. Tap a large space in the layout below. A/B are yellow-tag rows. C/D are red-tag rows.

Backup quick picker

🧭 Choose destination

Pickup defaults to Return Line. Washbay is the normal destination. Recognized Ford Transit, Chevrolet Express, GMC Savana, and Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vans default to Gravel; you can still choose Washbay or LOFR.

✅ Review & save

Saving keeps the time and photo. If the VIN already appears in Dirty and you're saving to Clean, it automatically moves that vehicle's current record to Clean and keeps its Dirty pickup time.

Dirty vehicles

📋 End the Day

Vehicle list with tag pictures, last 8 VIN, pickup, destination, and times. Generating the report does not delete anything.

Images are saved locally in this browser, not synced across devices. Same photo database as earlier CAK tracker versions. Scanning and NHTSA lookup need internet and may fail with glare; manual entry always works. Photos record local save time (displayed without the date).

Vehicle photo

🚗 CAK Employee Sign In

Employees: enter your E-number only. EAdmin: enter your administrator password. Your records stay saved on the team server.

Not signed in

👥 EAdmin — Team management

Admins see all employees' vehicle records in the tracker below. Each saved record is associated with the employee who created it.
